Master template

Seventeen layouts to build a new slide from. Copy the page you need and type into it.

01TitleOpen a deck or a chapter of one.
02Section dividerOpen a new part of the deck.
03StatementOne argument, said plainly, with a photograph.
04HighlightsThree or four figures that carry the page.
05Icon cardsA set of capabilities, services or principles.
06ComparisonTwo or three options read side by side.
07Org chart · reporting treeWho reports to whom, three levels at most.
08Org chart · flat team bandA team of peers, no hierarchy implied.
09Org chart · group structureA holding company and the businesses under it.
10ProcessStages that run in order, start to finish.
11TimelineDates in order, with what happened at each.
12InfographicOne visual in the middle, the parts around it.
13Image and specsOne project or product, pictured and specified.
14ProgrammeWork packages against a calendar.
15TableRows and columns, where the detail has to be exact.
16Full-bleed imageLet one photograph carry the page.
17ClosingEnd the deck: the ask, and how to reach you.
18AgendaWhat the deck covers, before it covers it.
19QuoteLet a client, or the board, say it instead of you.
20Before and afterTwo states of the same thing, side by side.
